name: Transformer tertiary bay arrangement
summary: Shows the assigned protection and switching interface of an accessible transformer tertiary winding.
description: Shows the assigned protection and switching interface of an accessible transformer tertiary winding. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Tertiary winding connection” at the input and “Tertiary circuit interface” at the output. An internal tertiary is not automatically externally accessible.
